generations.name: First generation (X243)
generations.notes: EQB 300/350 4MATIC: 66.5 kWh usable, 100 kW DC; EQB 250+ (from MY2023 Canada / MY2024 US after the 2024 facelift): 70.5 kWh usable, 100 kW DC. Packs differ by trim (powertrains), not by year, so one generation. Discontinued for North America after MY2025. Confidence: medium-high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_EQB ; https://insideevs.com/news/774141/mercedes-benz-eqb-discontinued/
